description: Evaluation suite verifying 4-mode execution (Modes A-D), 7 domain guardrail modules, anti-hallucination markers, and crisp separation from refine-prompt and skill catalog auditors.

evals.prompt: Implement a strictly typed Python batch compression utility with Pydantic v2 ConfigDict(extra='forbid'), CLI argparse flags, and actionable error recovery hints.
evals.expected_output: Enters MODE A — DIRECT EXECUTION with zero questions, produces modular <= 600-line Python code with full type hints and CLI verification commands, applies Mode D validation, and includes 1 simpler alternative.
assertions: Declares MODE A — DIRECT EXECUTION and asks 0 questions
Generates strictly typed Python code under Module M1 guardrails
Includes CLI verification command and 1 simpler alternative

evals.prompt: I want to build an automation suite for my local developer workflow and enterprise APIs, help me design where to start.
evals.expected_output: Enters MODE B — ITERATIVE REFINEMENT, asks 1 to 3 high-impact strategic questions, and supplies an initial structured draft with domain module alignment.
assertions: Limits clarifying questions to <= 3 strategic questions
Provides a preliminary structured architecture draft

evals.prompt: Design a multi-mode technical roadmap and comparative Tree-of-Thoughts architecture for migrating a legacy REST backend to FastAPI with OpenAPI 3.1 contracts and a PostgreSQL keyset query layer.
evals.expected_output: Enters MODE C — STRUCTURED PLANNING, starts with Phase 0 premises, compares 2-3 ToT branches (what changes, how it changes, trade-offs), details sequential CoT phases, and applies Enterprise Prompt 3 & 5 patterns.
assertions: Includes Phase 0 alignment before execution steps
Presents comparative ToT branch analysis with trade-offs and CoT stages

evals.prompt: Run an isolated epistemic feasibility audit ([FACT]/[INFERENCE]/[GAP]) and Socratic entropy modulation on my existing system prompt under OWASP LLM01 XML tags.
evals.expected_output: Does NOT trigger solution-content-architect; routes standalone prompt epistemic auditing and entropy modulation to refine-prompt.
assertions: Delegates isolated prompt auditing and entropy modulation to refine-prompt

evals.prompt: Audit this MCP server for STDIO stdout leaks, A2A JWS agent-card compliance, and unvalidated skill contracts.
evals.expected_output: Does NOT trigger solution-content-architect; routes MCP/A2A/skill compliance auditing to agent-server-auditor.
